title: Lamb and Pilaf Kebabs
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the richness of lamb with the nuttiness of pilaf, all wrapped up in a delicious kebab.

ingredients.name: turkish pilaf
ingredients.notes: preferably made with silkily textured rice

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
While the kebabs are cooking, toast the pilaf in a dry pan over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Once the kebabs are done, serve with a side of toasted pilaf and a squeeze of kissed lemon juice.
Optional: garnish with fresh herbs or a sprinkle of sumac.
